changes.details: Removed matchedSeed fallback in fetchInquiryStatusByToken. Enforces strict server lookup via /api/v1/rbpc/inquiries/status/{opaqueToken} with InquiryNotFoundError thrown on 404/network errors.
Verified endpoint /api/v1/rbpc/inquiries/status/{opaqueToken} returns 404 for nonexistent or invalid tokens, and strictly redacts PII (zero email, phone, personal name, or internal note disclosure).
6 unit & integration tests covering 404 for random/expired tokens, redacted response verification, seed reference rejection, and timing-safe lookup.

verification.zero_pii_audit: PASSED - contact_value, contact_channel, customer name, internal notes redacted
